title: Preservation of Scripture
definition: The preservation of Scripture is God's providential work of keeping His Word available to His people throughout history.
summary: God not only gave His Word but has faithfully preserved it. Through manuscripts, translations, preaching, teaching, and the work of the church, God has ensured that His truth remains available to every generation.
christFocus: Jesus declared that God's Word would not pass away. The preservation of Scripture supports Christ's mission by ensuring that the Gospel continues to be proclaimed throughout the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God has not abandoned His revelation. The same Lord who inspired Scripture has preserved it for the instruction and salvation of His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers can have confidence that they possess God's Word and are not relying on a lost or corrupted message.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Treasure access to Scripture. Read it regularly, memorize it, teach it faithfully, and help others gain access to God's Word.
